text.en: Đúng rồi! That means 'correct' — and you are!
text.zh: Đúng rồi！意思是'對了'——你就是對的！

text.en: Tuyệt! (That's 'awesome,' by the way.) 😎
text.zh: Tuyệt！(順便說，這是'太棒了'的意思。) 😎

text.en: YES. You heard it. I saw your ears work.
text.zh: 沒錯！你聽出來了。我看到你的耳朵在認真工作。

text.en: Giỏi quá! So clever.
text.zh: Giỏi quá！太聰明啦。

text.en: Nailed it. Don't even act surprised.
text.zh: 完美搞定。別裝作很意外的樣子。

text.en: Ooh, smooth. Do it again, I liked that.
text.zh: 哦，真順！再來一次，我喜歡。

text.en: Correct! Okay you're kind of good at this.
text.zh: 對了！好吧，你還挺有一套的。

text.en: That's the one! *leaf-sprouts wiggle*
text.zh: 就是這個！*頭頂的小葉子開心地抖了抖*

text.en: Perfect. We make a great team, huh?
text.zh: 完美。咱倆真是絕配，對吧？

text.en: Yep yep yep! Keep that energy.
text.zh: 對對對！保持這股勁兒！

text.en: Chuẩn! ('Spot on.') Look at you go.
text.zh: Chuẩn！('完全正確。') 看你多棒。

text.en: Easy for you now, apparently. Proud!
text.zh: 現在對你來說太輕鬆了嘛。我真驕傲！

text.en: Không sao! ('No worries.') Here's the one we wanted:
text.zh: Không sao！('沒關係。') 我們要的其實是這個：

text.en: Ooh, so close. That tone is genuinely sneaky. Look:
text.zh: 哦，差一點點。那個聲調真的很狡猾。看：

text.en: Honestly? That one got me too. The answer's:
text.zh: 說實話？這個我也答錯過。答案是：

text.en: Cố lên! ('Keep going!') Not quite — it's actually:
text.zh: Cố lên！('加油！') 還差一點——其實是：

text.en: Almost! Tiny miss. The word we needed:
text.zh: 就差一點！小小的失誤。我們要的詞是：

text.en: Nope — but a GOOD nope, you were close. It's:
text.zh: 不對——但是個'好的不對'，你很接近了。是：

text.en: Hmm, not this time. Let's see the right one together:
text.zh: 嗯，這次不對。我們一起看看正確的：

text.en: That meant something else (sneaky language). Here you go:
text.zh: 那個是別的意思（這語言真狡猾）。給你：

text.en: No biggie — even my leaves get confused. Correct one:
text.zh: 沒什麼大不了——連我的葉子都會搞混。正確的是：

text.en: Eh, language is tricky. Here's the fix:
text.zh: 唉，語言就是這麼難搞。這是正確答案：

text.en: Okay let's slow WAY down and do it together. Listen again:
text.zh: 好，我們放——慢——速度，一起來。再聽一遍：

text.en: Same one again — no rush. Here's a trick to remember it:
text.zh: 又是這一個——別急。教你一個記住它的小竅門：

text.en: Take a breath. We'll get this one. Tiny hint:
text.zh: 深呼吸。這個我們一定能拿下。小提示：

text.en: Lesson DONE! 🌟 {name}, you earned every bit of that gold.
text.zh: 這課搞定啦！🌟 {name}，這些金幣你每一枚都當之無愧。

text.en: And... finished! Feel how that got easier near the end? That's you learning in real time.
text.zh: 然後……完成！感覺到快結束時越來越容易了嗎？那就是你在實時進步。

text.en: We did it! High-five. (I have little starfruit hands but I mean it.)
text.zh: 我們做到了！擊個掌。(雖然我只有小小的楊桃手，但我是認真的。)

text.en: Complete! The tree grew a little taller today. 🌱
text.zh: 完成！今天這棵樹又長高了一點。🌱

text.en: That's a wrap! You knew zero of those words this morning. Wild.
text.zh: 收工！今天早上你這些詞一個都不會呢。太厲害了。

text.en: PERFECT lesson — no misses! Tuyệt vời! I'm framing this moment.
text.zh: 完美一課——一個都沒錯！Tuyệt vời！這一刻我要裱起來收藏。

text.en: Halfway! The hard part's behind us.
text.zh: 過半啦！難的部分已經過去了。

text.en: We're at the top of the hill — easy from here.
text.zh: 我們到山頂了——接下來就輕鬆啦。

text.en: Look, halfway already. Time flies when you're brilliant.
text.zh: 看，已經一半了。你這麼厲害，時間過得真快。

text.en: Three in a row! We're cooking. 🔥
text.zh: 連對三個！狀態來了。🔥

text.en: FIVE straight! Giỏi quá! Okay now I'm hyped.
text.zh: 連續五個！Giỏi quá！好吧我現在超激動。

text.en: TEN. In. A. ROW. Who ARE you?? Incredible.
text.zh: 連。對。十。個。你到底是誰啊？？太不可思議了。

text.en: Our first real words! Greetings and names — exactly what you'd say walking into a room in Vietnam. Let's make a first impression.
text.zh: 我們的第一批真正的詞！打招呼和名字——正是你走進越南房間時會說的話。來留個好的第一印象吧。

text.en: Time to be polite. Vietnamese has special words just for being nice, and people NOTICE when you use them. Free charm points.
text.zh: 該講禮貌啦。越南語有專門用來表示客氣的詞，你一用別人立刻就會注意到。白送的魅力值。

text.en: Café time! ☕ My favorite. We're going to order drinks like we belong here.
text.zh: 咖啡時間！☕ 我的最愛。我們要像本地人一樣點飲料。

text.en: Food and prices — the two things you'll use most, honestly. Let's not overpay, okay?
text.zh: 食物和價格——說實話，這兩樣你用得最多。咱們別買貴了，好嗎？

text.en: The market! It's loud, it's fun, and we're going to bargain a little. Confidence is the trick.
text.zh: 菜市場！熱鬧又好玩，我們還要稍微砍砍價。訣竅就是要有自信。

text.en: Numbers, leveled up. Big ones now. Don't panic — there's a pattern, and patterns are my thing.
text.zh: 數字升級版。這次是大數字了。別慌——它有規律，而規律正是我的強項。

text.en: Getting around! Grab, taxis, motorbikes, directions. Let's make sure we never get lost.
text.zh: 出行啦！打車軟件、出租車、摩托車、問路。咱們保證絕不迷路。

text.en: Everyday life stuff — the words you'd actually use every single day. The quiet useful ones.
text.zh: 日常生活用語——那些你每天真的會用到的詞。低調又實用的那種。

text.en: Talking with people! Making friends, small talk. This is where Vietnamese starts to feel real.
text.zh: 和人聊天啦！交朋友、閒聊。從這裡開始，越南語會變得真實起來。

text.en: The Vietnamese alphabet looks almost like English... and then it has extra letters wearing little hats. Let's meet them.
text.zh: 越南語字母看起來幾乎和英語一樣……然後還多了幾個'戴著小帽子'的字母。我們來認識它們吧。

text.en: Vowels first. These are the sounds everything else sits on top of. Open your ears!
text.zh: 先學元音。所有其他聲音都建立在它們之上。豎起耳朵！

text.en: Now the special vowels — ơ, ư, ê, ô. English doesn't have these, so they feel weird at first. That's normal!
text.zh: 現在是特殊元音——ơ、ư、ê、ô。英語裡沒有這些，所以一開始會覺得怪怪的。很正常！

text.en: Consonants time. Most are easy. A couple are sneaky. I'll warn you about the sneaky ones.
text.zh: 輔音時間。大部分都很簡單。有幾個很狡猾。狡猾的那幾個我會提前提醒你。

text.en: Ending sounds matter a LOT in Vietnamese. A different ending = a different word. Let's get them crisp.
text.zh: 在越南語裡，結尾的音超——級——重要。結尾不同 = 詞就不同。我們把它們念清楚。

text.en: Two vowels holding hands! When they team up, they make a brand new sound. Cute, honestly.
text.zh: 兩個元音手拉手！它們組隊時會發出一個全新的音。說真的，挺可愛的。

text.en: THE BIG ONE. Tones. Today just two: a flat one and a falling one. Hear the difference and you're already winning.
text.zh: 重頭戲來了。聲調。今天只學兩個：一個平的，一個降的。能聽出區別，你就已經贏了。

text.en: Adding the rising tone — it goes UP, like a question your voice asks. Listen for the lift.
text.zh: 加上升調——它往上揚，就像你的聲音在提問。注意聽那個上揚。

text.en: Now the dipping tone — it dives down then climbs back. It's the dramatic one. I love it.
text.zh: 現在是曲折調——先往下俯衝再爬上來。它是最有戲劇性的那個。我超喜歡。

text.en: Hỏi vs ngã — okay these two are TWINS and even I mix them up. We'll figure them out together.
text.zh: Hỏi 和 ngã——好吧這倆是雙胞胎，連我都會搞混。我們一起把它們弄明白。

text.en: All six tones at once. This felt impossible to me a week ago and now look at me. You're gonna get it.
text.zh: 六個聲調一起來。一週前我覺得這根本不可能，現在你看我。你也一定能行。

text.en: Your turn to SAY them. Be brave, be loud, be a little silly. Nobody's judging — I'm a fruit.
text.zh: 輪到你來'說'了。大膽點、大聲點、傻一點也沒關係。沒人會笑話你——我可是個水果。

text.en: Let's match each little mark to its sound. Once you can read the marks, you can read the tones. Superpower unlocked.
text.zh: 我們把每個小符號和它的聲音對上號。一旦你能讀懂這些符號，就能讀懂聲調。超能力解鎖。

text.en: Checkpoint! Show me your ears are ready. Get through this and Unit 1 opens up. I believe in you.
text.zh: 關卡測試！讓我看看你的耳朵準備好了。通過它，第一單元就解鎖了。我相信你。

text.en: Hi! I'm Bé Khế — a little starfruit who's learning Vietnamese, same as you. Want to learn it together?
text.zh: 嗨！我是 Bé Khế——一顆正在學越南語的小楊桃，跟你一樣。想一起學嗎？

text.en: Oh, a new friend! I'm Bé Khế. I'm a star, technically. Cut a starfruit and — ta-da — star. Anyway, let's learn Vietnamese!
text.zh: 哦，新朋友！我是 Bé Khế。嚴格來說我是顆星星。把楊桃切開——噔噔——就是星星。總之，我們來學越南語吧！

text.en: Before anything — listen to these two. Tell me: same word, or different?
text.zh: 先別急——聽聽這兩個。告訴我：是同一個詞，還是不同的？

text.en: DIFFERENT! Same letters, but the TONE changed the whole meaning. Vietnamese has six of these. Wild, right?
text.zh: 不同！字母一樣，但'聲調'改變了整個意思。越南語有六個聲調。很神奇吧？

text.en: Here's the secret: once your ears can hear the six tones, the rest gets WAY easier. So that's where we start. Tới luôn — let's go!
text.zh: 悄悄告訴你：一旦你的耳朵能聽出這六個聲調，後面就會簡單得多。所以我們就從這裡開始。Tới luôn——出發！

text.en: This is our map! We start at the very bottom and climb. Tap the glowing one — that's our first stop.
text.zh: 這是我們的地圖！我們從最底下開始往上爬。點那個發光的——那是我們的第一站。

text.en: First up: Foundations. We learn to HEAR Vietnamese before we speak it. It's the most important part, so we do it first.
text.zh: 第一步：基礎。我們要先學會'聽'越南語，再開口說。這是最重要的部分，所以先做它。

text.en: See these? They're your tries. Run out and we take a little break — no big deal, they come back.
text.zh: 看到這些了嗎？它們是你的嘗試機會。用完了我們就休息一下——沒關係，它們會回來的。

text.en: That's everything! Okay okay okay — I'm excited. Let's actually start.
text.zh: 就這些啦！好好好——我太興奮了。我們正式開始吧。

text.en: You PASSED! 🏆 Ears officially tuned. The next chapter is yours.
text.zh: 你通過啦！🏆 耳朵正式調好了。下一章是你的了。

text.en: Checkpoint cleared! I never doubted us. (Okay, maybe a little. Not anymore.)
text.zh: 關卡通過！我從沒懷疑過我們。(好吧，也許有一點點。現在不會了。)

text.en: Giỏi quá! That's a real milestone. Gold well earned.
text.zh: Giỏi quá！這是個真正的里程碑。金幣實至名歸。

text.en: Not through yet — and that's totally fine. Tests are just practice with a fancy hat. Let's run it back.
text.zh: 還沒過關——不過完全沒關係。測驗只是戴了頂花哨帽子的練習而已。我們再來一次。

text.en: Almost there! A couple slipped. We'll warm those up and try again — no shame, only reps.
text.zh: 就差一點！漏掉了幾個。我們把它們複習熱身一下再試——不丟人，只是多練幾遍。

text.en: Trees don't grow in one day. Quick review, then we go again. Cố lên!
text.zh: 樹不是一天長成的。快速複習一下，然後再來。Cố lên！

text.en: A new chapter just opened! *flips the book dramatically* Come see.
text.zh: 新的一章剛剛開啟！*戲劇性地翻開書* 快來看。

text.en: Level up! 🌟 New words, new places, same great team.
text.zh: 升級啦！🌟 新單詞、新地方、還是這個超棒的團隊。

text.en: Ding! You unlocked the next part of the map. The adventure continues.
text.zh: 叮！你解鎖了地圖的下一部分。冒險繼續。

text.en: Day one! Every tree starts with one seed. See you tomorrow? 🌱
text.zh: 第一天！每棵樹都從一顆種子開始。明天見？🌱

text.en: Three days straight! A habit is sprouting. I can feel it.
text.zh: 連續三天！一個習慣正在發芽。我能感覺到。

text.en: A WHOLE WEEK! 🔥 Seven days. You're not messing around.
text.zh: 整整一週！🔥 七天。你可不是鬧著玩的。

text.en: Thirty days! 🌳 Look at this tree we grew. I'm a little emotional.
text.zh: 三十天！🌳 看看我們種出的這棵樹。我有點感動了。

text.en: ONE HUNDRED DAYS. {name}. You're basically my hero now. Giỏi quá nhất! (The MOST clever.)
text.zh: 一百天。{name}。你現在基本上是我的英雄了。Giỏi quá nhất！(最最聰明！)

text.en: You're back! 🌟 I kept your spot warm. Ready when you are.
text.zh: 你回來啦！🌟 我幫你把位子留著呢。你準備好我就開始。

text.en: There you are! No 'where were you' from me — just happy you're here. Let's go.
text.zh: 你在這兒呀！我才不會問'你去哪了'——只是很高興你來了。走吧。

text.en: Welcome back, friend! The tree missed you. Let's water it.
text.zh: 歡迎回來，朋友！這棵樹想你了。我們來給它澆澆水。

text.en: Psst — your streak's about to wilt! One quick lesson keeps it alive. I'll wait right here.
text.zh: 噓——你的連勝快蔫了！一節小課就能保住它。我就在這兒等你。

text.en: Streak reset — but hey, trees regrow. We plant a new one today. Không sao!
text.zh: 連勝歸零了——不過嘿，樹會重新長的。我們今天種一棵新的。Không sao！

text.en: Lost the streak, kept the words. That part's still yours. Let's start a fresh one.
text.zh: 連勝丟了，單詞還在。那部分依然是你的。我們重新開始一條吧。

text.en: Nothing here yet — but down there? That glowing lesson has your name on it.
text.zh: 這裡還什麼都沒有——但下面那個？那節發光的課寫著你的名字呢。

text.en: Your notebook's empty for now. Finish a lesson and I'll jot down everything we learn. ✏️
text.zh: 你的筆記本現在還是空的。上完一節課，我就把我們學的所有東西都記下來。✏️
